target.name: xx Packaging glass, white, at plant

strategy.label: template transfer drafted by the LLM pipeline from xx Packaging glass, white, at plant [RER]
strategy.note: The RER dataset is the same product - white packaging glass, 1 kg, a 21-input unit process - and the DE one is a regional copy of it; the brown and green grades differ in colour and cullet share. Differences: The target is CH and describes Vetropack's own Swiss glass sites; the template is a European average. The target's includedProcesses lists the same steps (cullet preparation, melting, forming, cooling, packaging), so no structural difference is visible. 9 of 21 amounts free within 0.5-2x of the template. Review the choice of template; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

evidence.source: bafu-2026: xx Packaging glass, white, at plant [RER] (unit process, 21 inputs)

gaps_reported_by_model: The cullet share of Vetropack's Swiss sites is not printed anywhere; it is fitted within 0.5-2x of the European value.
